scientific_integrity: The established qualitative monotonicity and known exact Steiner area formulas are attributed to earlier sources. The claim is the strict Bernstein curvature hierarchy and optimal modulus.
scientific_limitations: Only planar filled ellipses; quantitative novelty remains subject to external priority checking; numerical checks are not proof for all parameters.
title: Strict Bernstein curvature and sharp angular stability for Minkowski sums of planar ellipses
